messages:
Alex T: Hey team — quick sync. AWS/GCP/Azure listing kickoff for Redwood Inference. Need owners for creds, branding assets, and legal artifacts. Can we triage today?
Maria (Partnerships): I can own creds + publisher portal provisioning. Need IAM roles and contact for cloud account.
Sara - PM: I'll take packaging (trial SKU, pricing tier, trial duration) and docs/quickstart.
Kevin - Legal: I can drive legal artifacts (EULA, privacy addendum). Need draft terms from product.
Maria (Partnerships): @Kevin - Legal where do we stand on templates? any new clauses for quantized models or telemetry?
Kevin - Legal: No new model-specific clauses yet. We should add a short paragraph re: telemetry endpoints and opt-out. I'll draft and share by EOD.
Alex T: Nice. For assets: logos (SVG + 300x300 PNG), 1-sentence blurb, 200-400 word description, screenshots. @Maria where to upload?
Maria (Partnerships): Drop into S3: s3://redwood-partner-assets/marketplace/redwood-inference/
Maria (Partnerships): Public naming convention: redwood-inference_logo_300.png and redwood-inference_banner.svg
Sara - PM: For trial SKU: proposing 14-day trial, 10k token free trial credit, single-seat. Thoughts?
Kevin - Legal: Trial terms look fine, but ensure billing metering doc is attached for marketplace teams.
Alex T: Ok owners: Maria = creds & assets upload, Sara = packaging + pricing, Kevin = legal. I'll coordinate cloud vendor contacts and announcement timeline.
Marketplace Bot: JIRA ticket created: MKP-4821 "Redwood Inference: three-cloud listing - assets & legal" — assignees Maria, Sara, Kevin — due 2024-05-03
Maria (Partnerships): Linking cloud contacts: AWS: priya@aws-partners, GCP: jon.gcp@partners, Azure: carlos@azuremarketplace. I'll request publisher roles today.
Sara - PM: I'll prepare the quickstart snippet. Draft:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"redwood/llama-2-instruct","input":"hello"}'
```
Alex T: Perfect. One more: we need billing meter mapping file for each marketplace. Maria can you ask finance for the SKU mapping?
Maria (Partnerships): On it — looping in @Finance in the ticket.
Kevin - Legal: Once my draft is ready I'll post to the ticket and ping legal-ops. Expect before EOD. :+1:
Alex T: Great. Target milestone: publisher portal ready + assets + legal by end of week so we can schedule publisher onboarding next Tue. Any blockers?
Sara - PM: Nothing blocker-wise from docs side. Might need a screenshot of console that requires dedicated capacity UI from eng.
Maria (Partnerships): I'll collect screenshots. If eng can give short demo video that helps for listing page.
Alex T: Thanks everyone. I'll update timeline in MKP-4821. :rocket:
